extension.description: Highlight selected words across the files you are editing
command.highlightSelectedWords.title: Highlight/Unhighlight Selected Words
command.clearHighlightWords.title: Clear all Highlight Words
command.nextOccurrence.title: Go to Next Highlight
command.previousOccurrence.title: Go to Previous Highlight
command.removeWord.title: Remove Highlighted Words...
config.title: Highlight
config.wholeWord.description: Whether to highlight whole words only.
config.ignoreCase.description: Whether to ignore case when highlighting.
config.colors.description: Colors used for highlighting. Each item has a light and a dark color.
